speaker: Kim
text: Did anyone watch the football last night? What a finish.

speaker: Jo
text: I fell asleep at half time, don't spoil it.

speaker: Lee
text: Too late, it was three nil at the end.

speaker: Kim
text: Anyway, the barbecue at my place on Saturday is still on if the weather holds.

speaker: Pat
text: I'll bring the veggie burgers again, people actually ate them last time.

speaker: Lee
text: I'm out, I'm on vacation in Lisbon from Friday.

speaker: Kim
text: Lisbon in November? Nice, eat a pastel de nata for me.

speaker: Pat
text: Oh, before I forget, the company domain expires on Thursday and the renewal reminder keeps bouncing.

speaker: Pat
text: Jo, can you renew the domain? You have the registrar login.

speaker: Jo
text: Yes, I'll renew the domain today, right after this.

speaker: Pat
text: Thanks, that would have been embarrassing.

speaker: Lee
text: Speaking of embarrassing, my cat sat on my keyboard during the all-hands yesterday.

speaker: Kim
text: I saw that, the whole company saw that.

speaker: Pat
text: Should we order pizza for Friday lunch?

speaker: Kim
text: Sure, maybe, let's see who's around.

speaker: Lee
text: Pineapple or no pineapple, that's the real question.

speaker: Jo
text: No pineapple, this is not up for discussion.
